updates.message:
🌅 Good evening Jackie! Quick evening wrap-up from Boca Raton — it's around 86°F and partly cloudy tonight, with a chance of scattered thunderstorms later. A nice evening to enjoy the covered patio, but keep an eye on those storms rolling through.

⚡ France Trip Alert — Still Urgent: The ATC strike situation in Paris has gotten worse. French ATC unions are forcing mandatory capacity cuts of up to 40% at Paris CDG and Orly, and the disruption isn't just on strike days — it's affecting overflight routes too. The EU's new Entry/Exit biometric border system also went live in April, causing long queue spillovers at CDG. If you haven't yet locked in flexible tickets and travel insurance for your July trip, now is really the time. The summer 2026 Europe strike picture is the worst in years across France, Spain, Germany, and Italy all at once.
